tickets.title: Search results are missing newly added products
tickets.description: Products added to the Brightline Retail catalog after 15 September do not appear in storefront search.

tickets.title: Search autocomplete is slower than 800 ms
tickets.description: Autocomplete latency on the Brightline Retail storefront rose from 200 ms to over 800 ms during peak hours.

tickets.title: Customers receive duplicate invoice emails
tickets.description: Kestrel Bank customers received every invoice email two or three times on 9 September.

tickets.title: Invoice CSV export is missing the tax column
tickets.description: The monthly CSV export no longer includes the VAT amount per invoice.

tickets.title: Single sign-on loops back to the login page on staging
tickets.description: Oakridge Health testers are sent back to the login page after signing in to the Harbor staging portal.
